methodological_audit.scope: Post-test audit and descriptive robustness only; no new predictions or model selection
methodological_audit.verdict: Scientifically defensible exploratory external temporal holdout; insufficient for broad multisite or guaranteed zero-shot generalization.
methodological_audit.original_ci_class: Exploratory calendar-month cluster resampling; not a verified stationary/moving-block bootstrap and not a calibrated 95%coverage guarantee.
methodological_audit.interval_class: DEV residual empirical intervals; no exchangeability/conformal coverage guarantee.
methodological_audit.foundation_pretraining_overlap: Unknown; chronological target holdout does not prove source-model corpus is disjoint.
documentation_corrections: Origin eligibility code has future-label availability clause; audit quantify its actual effect, do not conflate with deployment eligibility.
Temporal held-out2025 is untuned confirmation, not verified absence from foundation pretraining.
NLR facility power is component-sum derived label, not independent total meter or all8Googlecells.
Originalprotocol resource text says emergency checks; implementation lacks continuous/intercall memory guard. This does not affect forecast metrics.
